verdict.rationale: Bento lets users write alert rules and signals in plain English. These compile to trace queries, fire in real time on matching events, and route to Slack, PagerDuty, email, or webhook. Trigger-based fixes (skills/subagents) are also promoted automatically, and signals can be edited from the CLI. missing for 10: detailed docs on rule syntax and configuration, actions beyond notification/webhook routing (e.g., remediation steps per rule), independent or hands-on corroboration.
